- name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when not supplied.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already
            lives at the same address with the same last name (a shared household).
            Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The pet owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted as '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer

## What I implemented

The `sharesHousehold` flag previously only *skipped* the duplicate-household rejection. Now, when true, the new owner joins the existing same-lastName/same-address household and every member shares one stable `householdId`, which is returned.

**Changes, each in the place it belongs:**

1. **`Households` helper** (`rest/function/owner/Households.java`) — the natural home for household logic. Added:
   - `matches(owner, lastName, address)` — canonical (case/whitespace-insensitive) household membership check.
   - `id(lastName, address)` — derives the shared id (`H-<12 upper-hex of SHA-256(key)>`). It's *stable* by construction: derived purely from the canonical household key, so all members compute the same value with no coordination.

2. **`EnsureUniqueHousehold`** — refactored to reuse `Households.matches` instead of duplicating the normalize-and-compare loop.

3. **`AssignHousehold`** (new function, single responsibility) — when `sharesHousehold` is true and an existing owner already occupies the household, stamps that shared id on both the new owner and every existing member (saving them). Owners not in a shared household keep a null id.

4. **Pipeline** (`owners.POST.yml`) — inserted an `assignHousehold` step after `build`, under the same `transaction` governance.

5. **Persistence & DTO plumbing:**
   - `Owner` entity: `household_id` column + accessors + `toString`.
   - All four DB schemas (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`): added the `household_id` column.
   - `openapi.yml`: added read-only `householdId` to the `Owner` schema, so it's returned.
   - `OwnerMapper`: `toOwnerDto` maps it automatically; the body→entity `toOwner(OwnerFieldsDto)` ignores it (assigned by the function, never from the request).

The acceptance test's two shared-household joiners now return the same non-blank `householdId`.
